title: Share labels without copying names or losing memberships
preconditions: A disposable Saga has two features and labels DevOps and Reliability.

steps.action: Assign DevOps to both features and Reliability additionally to one.
steps.expected_result: Both share one DevOps identity, and the second assignment does not copy the label name into the plan.

steps.action: Rename DevOps to Platform operations and inspect the feature plans and pages.
steps.expected_result: Every assigned feature displays the new name without membership changes.

steps.action: Change only priority, inspect labels, then explicitly clear labels.
steps.expected_result: Omission preserves the existing label assignment; explicit clearing removes all assignments.

expected_result: Share labels without copying names or losing memberships.
